title: Late Shang at Yin Xu
summary: The late Shang capital near present-day Anyang preserved inscribed oracle bones alongside palaces, tombs and bronze objects. The inscriptions offer evidence of writing, divination and social organization.

claims.text: The late Shang capital near present-day Anyang preserved inscribed oracle bones alongside palaces, tombs and bronze objects. The inscriptions offer evidence of writing, divination and social organization.
Site chronology from UNESCO; individual inscriptions are not all the same age.
Written and material evidence meet at this site. Oracle-bone texts illuminate particular royal practices; they do not provide an unrestricted account of everyone living under Shang authority.
